styleLock.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal #1B1B1D sections and panel-white #F4F5F6 sections, with brushed-silver #C9CCD0 metal panels for infographic blocks
styleLock.lightingSystem: neutral-cool directional studio key at 5600K, controlled metal speculars, soft contact shadows; dark sections with dramatic falloff, light sections bright and even
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed steel plate, light marble floor, matte jobsite workbench surfaces
styleLock.typography: bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; headline fills are brushed-metal #C9CCD0 on dark sections and charcoal #2D2D2D on light sections
styleLock.iconSystem: filled rounded red #D6302E icons, thin red divider bars, red numbered circles, consistent across the set
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent product scale; structure annotations use small round accent dots with thin leader lines; no floating product, contact shadow always present
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent industrial power-tool ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep charcoal #1B1B1D, panel white #F4F5F6, brushed silver #C9CCD0 and one signal-red accent #D6302E; neutral-cool directional studio lighting at 5600K with controlled metal speculars and soft contact shadows; bold modern geometric sans-serif headlines; consistent filled rounded red icons, thin red divider bars and red numbered circles; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins on light panels; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 源图为 10 片 800x1200 详情页长图切片（相邻重叠 60px），主产品为锂电冲击手电钻，与源文件夹名『大功率电钻』一致。归类依据 taxonomy：电动工具无独立大类，取 L1=家装灯具 / L2=五金工具（精确串），与库内铰链、卸扣（L2=五金）两份模版可区分。已剥离：红色 LOGO 徽章、模板站水印（含会员二维码与乱码英文文案）、电压/螺丝数/频率等具体数值（改为 callout 文案槽位由使用方填写）、原文案。源图无独立痛点镜，漏斗按工具类重排为 动力首图→机制→双速→续航对比→场景→步骤→参数→多档→信任收口；电机机制图与信任网格为产品不出镜信息图，prompt 以 for {product} 保占位。电池对比的绿色 #3FA934 仅作语义状态色。
